# RealTime_Forecasting

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The ability to generate predictions of future system states at the same rate as incoming data, without batch processing delays. Enables edge and in-network applications where latency is critical, a core goal of iNEST's neuromorphic computing paradigm.
